name: Product gallery
summary: The top of a product page: a swipeable photo gallery with dots on a phone and thumbnails from tablet up, name, sale price, rating, colour swatches, size chips with one sold out, Add to bag and save.
use: at the top of a product page, for choosing colour and size
a11y: The gallery is a focusable group that arrow keys move through, with named dots and thumbnails; colour and size are native radio groups (the sold-out size is disabled and named so), and the prices and rating are read as words.

use_when: any single item sold in variants, such as shoes, bags or homeware, where the buyer picks options before adding it
avoid_when: many products in a grid or list: use product-card or wishlist-grid
the bag or checkout after adding: use cart-drawer or order-summary
a product with no options to pick: product-card with an add button is enough

parts.name: photos
parts.what: one product photo in the swipeable track

parts.name: dots
parts.what: one dot per photo, shown on phones

parts.name: thumbs
parts.what: one thumbnail per photo, shown from tablet width up

parts.name: price
parts.what: the price now, the old price struck through and a sale tag

parts.name: rating
parts.what: stars, the average and the review count, as a button to the reviews

parts.name: colours
parts.what: one colour swatch in a radio group; the picked name shows in the legend

parts.name: sizes
parts.what: one size chip in a radio group; a sold-out size is disabled and struck through

parts.name: stock
parts.what: a low-stock note under the sizes

parts.name: add
parts.what: the main action, which reads Added to bag for a moment

parts.name: save
parts.what: heart toggle to save to a wishlist

parts.name: perks
parts.what: one delivery or returns line with an icon

empty.how: with no photos, show the sunken track at its 4 by 5 shape with a muted product icon and hide the dots and thumbnails

loading.how: keep the sunken photo box and fill the name, price and chips with muted blocks; disable Add to bag until loaded

error.how: if adding fails, put the button label back and say so in the live region, or show a toast-stack message

disabled.how: a sold-out size is a disabled radio, greyed and struck through

overflow.how: photos sit side by side in their own swipeable track that snaps one photo at a time

long_text.how: the name wraps; the price, old price and sale tag wrap onto a second line when tight

keyboard: Tab reaches the photo track, the dots or thumbnails, the rating, the colour and size groups, Add to bag and Save
Left and Right arrows on the focused photo track move one photo at a time
Arrow keys move within the colour and size groups, as in any native radio group, and skip the sold-out size
Enter or Space presses Add to bag, Save, the rating, a dot or a thumbnail
